description: New two storey semi-detached dwelling with habitable roof space and associated Parking. Landscaping, Amenity space,  Waste and Cycle storage
decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:</p><p>A100; A101; A102; A103; A204; A305; A306; A307; A308; A309; A310; A311; A412; A613; FL153 Landscape Specifications; FL153 Materials Schedule; FL153 Waste Bins Storage; FL153 Cycle Storage Details; FL153 (SuDS); Design and Access Statement &amp; Planning Statement [project ref: FL153]; Biodiversity Net Gain Assessment [ref: GCA153FL - V1, dated 09/04/2026]; Sunlight Daylight report [ref: GCA153FL, dated 08 April 2026/V.01]; Arboricultural Report&amp; Tree Protection Plan [ref: GCC153TP, 08 April 2026]; Waste Management Plan [ref: GCE153FL Version 2, 08 April 2026]; Fire Strategy Report [ref: GCE153FL Version 1, 09 April 2026]; Flood Risk Assessment and Suds [ref: GCE153FL – V3, 20/05/2026]; Sustainability Statement [GCE153FL Version 2, 08 April 2026]; (CMS) Construction Method Statement and (CLP) Construction Logistics Plan [GCE153FL Version 2; 08 April 2026]</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the details otherwise approved, no development shall take place, until a Detailed Construction Method Statement &amp; Logistics Plan has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority, in accordance with the format and guidance provided by Transport for London – www.tfl.gov.uk. The Detailed Construction Logistics Plan shall provide for:</p><p>a) Site layout plan;</p><p>b) The parking of vehicles of site operatives and visitors;</p><p>c) HGV access to site – loading and unloading of plant and materials; and number of HGV’s anticipated;</p><p>d) Loading and unloading of plant and materials;</p><p>e) Storage of plant and materials used in constructing the development;</p><p>f) Highway condition (before, during, after);</p><p>g) Measures to control the emission of dust and dirt during construction; and</p><p>h) Scheme for recycling/disposing of waste resulting from demolition and</p><p>construction works.</p><p>i) Details showing the frontage/ the boundary of the site enclosed by site hording to a minimum height of 2 metres.</p><p>j) Details on the erection and use of tall plant (e.g. tower cranes (incl. slew radius), mobile cranes (incl. slew radius) and piling rigs)</p><p>The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Detailed Construction Logistics Plan, or any amendment or variation to it as may be agreed in writing by the local planning authority.</p><p>REASON: To minimise the impacts of construction upon the amenities of neighbouring occupiers and to ensure that development does not adversely affect safety on the transport network in accordance with Local Plan Policy M3 and Policy D14 of the London Plan (2021) and to ensure that the transport network impact of construction work associated with the development is managed in accordance with Policy T7 of the London Plan (2021).</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the details shown on the approved plans the development, shall not commence until the following have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority:</p><p>(i) Full details of the levels of the building, forecourt, and rear garden area in relation to the existing site, and adjoining land and highway(s), and any other changes proposed in the levels of the site</p><p>The proposed details shall therefore be implemented in accordance with the approved plans and retained as such thereafter. This is a PRE-COMMENCEMENT condition.</p><p>REASON: To ensure that the works are carried out at suitable levels in relation to the highway and adjoining properties, and in the interests of the amenity of neighbouring residents, and to protect the appearance of the development, drainage, and gradient of access in accordance with Policy GR1 of the Harrow Local Plan.</p>

<p>No development shall take place until (revised) works for the disposal of surface water and works for surface water attenuation and storage have been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority. These details shall include:</p><p>1) Full details of surface water attenuation storage calculations</p><p>2) Details of pump and outfall details.</p><p>3) Details of Compensatory Flood Storage</p><p>The development shall be carried out in accordance with the details so agreed and shall be retained as such thereafter.</p><p>REASON: To ensure that the development achieves an appropriate run-off rate in this high risk flood area and to ensure that sustainable urban drainage measures are utilised.</p>

<p>The proposed development shall be completed in full adherence to the submitted arboricultural details, Arboricultural Report &amp; Tree Protection Plan [ref: GCC153TP, 08 April 2026], unless first otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.</p><p>REASON: To ensure that the trees to be retained on the site are not adversely affected by any proposed works, in accordance with policy DM22 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013).</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no development which would otherwise fall within Classes A, AA, B, and D in Part 1 of Schedule 2 to that Order shall be carried out without the prior written permission of the local planning authority.</p><p>REASON: To safeguard the character of the locality and the amenity of the future and neighbouring residents.</p>

<p>No development shall take place until a foul water drainage strategy, has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority in writing to be agreed. The development shall not be occupied until the agreed drainage strategy has been implemented.</p><p>REASON: To ensure that there would be adequate infrastructure in place for the disposal of foul water arising from the development.</p>

<p>The windows in the first floor flank elevation of the development facing no. 5 shall: (a) be of purpose-made obscure glass, (b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level and shall thereafter be retained in that form.</p><p>REASON: To safeguard the residential amenities of neighbouring residents, in accordance with Policy DM1 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013).</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the details shown on the approved plans, the development hereby approved shall not commence until a revised Fire Safety Statement and revised internal layout as needed, has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The proposed details shall therefore be implemented in accordance with the approved plans and retained as such thereafter. This is a PRE-COMMENCEMENT condition.</p><p>REASON: To improve upon the submitted information, and to ensure that the fire safety of the proposed building is managed in a satisfactory manner and that the development contributes to fire safety in line with Policy D12A of the London Plan (2021).</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.</p><p>REASON: To safeguard the residential amenities of neighbouring residents, in accordance with Policy DM1 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013).</p>

<p>The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall be implemented as per the details approved herein.</p><p>REASON: To safeguard the character and appearance of the area in accordance with Policy GR1 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041).</p>

<p>The refuse and waste bins shall be stored at all times, other than on collection days, within the designated refuse storage areas as shown on the approved plans.</p><p>REASON: To enhance the appearance of the development and safeguard the character and appearance of the area.</p>

<p>No development shall commence until a Self-Build BNG Exemption Statement has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Statement shall demonstrate that the development qualifies for the self-build and custom housebuilding exemption from the biodiversity gain planning condition and shall include:</p><p>(a) details of how the dwelling is to be commissioned by an individual or individuals who will occupy that dwelling as their home;</p><p>(b) evidence that the individual(s) referred to in (a) has had primary input into the design and layout of their dwelling;</p><p>(c) details of the intended occupier (where known), and the mechanism by which they will commission the build;</p><p>(d) a statement confirming that the development will consist exclusively of self-build or custom housebuilding within the meaning of section 1(A1) of the Self-build and Custom Housebuilding Act 2015. The statement shall include a statutory declaration setting out how the development complies with the self-build requirements or the applicant's contract with a builder</p><p>(e) such other information as is reasonably required by the Local Planning Authority to verify that the development meets the criteria for exemption from the statutory biodiversity gain condition.</p><p>The development shall be carried out only in accordance with the approved Self-Build BNG Exemption Statement.</p><p>Reason: To enable the Local Planning Authority to determine whether the development qualifies for exemption from the statutory biodiversity gain condition, and to ensure that the development accords with the requirements for self-build and custom housebuilding, in accordance with Schedule 7A of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, the Biodiversity Gain Requirements (Exemptions) Regulations 2024, and section 1(A1) of the Self-build and Custom Housebuilding Act 2015.</p>
